name: Nagai Shuzo
about: Nagai Shuzo was founded in 1886 in Kawaba, a mountain village in northern Gunma, by Shoji Nagai, who chose the place for its water. Rain and snow on Mount Hotaka filter through the Oze area to reach it, and the family later bought the forest along both banks of the stream to protect it.

Mizubasho, the main label, began in 1992. In 2008 the brewery developed MIZUBASHO PURE, a sparkling sake given its second fermentation in the bottle. Vintage and dessert sakes followed, and together they make up NAGAI STYLE, a set intended to carry a meal from start to finish.
